# Resource or correction

Describe the resource or the problem with the existing entry.

## Why it belongs here

Explain the task it helps with and your experience or evidence. Mention any relationship to the project, required host tools, and commercial licensing.

## Checks

- [ ] The link points to the canonical source and opens successfully.
- [ ] The description is specific, accurate, and ends with a period.
- [ ] The entry is in the most relevant section and alphabetical position.
- [ ] Existing entries and the table of contents remain consistent.
